channel.title: Argus Changelog
channel.description: Release history for Argus, the hundred-eyed security auditor.

item.description: New app icon and logo mark across every platform and the in-app idle-screen mark.
Removed the fabricated "estimated watch" duration, wired real per-agent completion into Live Attack, and fixed Dashboard's agent count to match the real 19-agent roster.
Redesigned all three desktop screens to the "keeper's watch-ledger" visual world with a real rotating Fibonacci-sphere eye field and no-scroll layouts.
Fixed a sandboxed target's port being published to every network interface, a real repo's .git/.env leaking into a generated sandbox, and a secret-detection bug hiding a real password.
Phase 2 can now sandbox almost any repo via an LLM-written, verified-before-trusted Dockerfile when no deterministic stack probe matches.
Fixed a false-positive hardcoded-DB-connection-string secret, and Phase 2 now auto-sandboxes plain static sites and basic PHP apps.
Smoother, crisper desktop UI — uniform 140ms transitions, press-down button feedback, and fade-and-rise screen navigation.
Argus now reports when a scan is blocked by bot protection, and New Scan gained two clear modes: Code vs Website.
Fixed Reports showing a misleading "closed since" diff across different scan targets.
A fresh desktop install now starts with an empty Recent Scans list instead of showing a previous install's history.
argus mcp-server now prints a clean install hint instead of a raw traceback when the optional [mcp] extra is missing.
Fixed blind SSRF/SQLi/XSS callback detection silently failing against Argus's own Docker-sandboxed targets.
Fixed Phase 2 attacking github.com itself when given a .git repo URL — a git clone URL is now refused as an attack target.
Fixed the desktop app going "Not Responding" under heavy local-LLM load, a double-tooltip glitch, and risk-score alignment issues.
A systematic full-codebase audit found and fixed six real bugs across the GUI, backend pipeline, and attack agents.
Fixed the cloud LLM provider picker silently reverting, "Strike the app" not skipping static analysis, and a stuck-looking static-analysis-only progress screen.
Halved Settings page load time, restored 5 real agents the GUI had silently hidden, and fixed a dead Export report button.
Added batch scanning, the SSTIProber agent, rate limiting, request logging, explicit attack authorization, and launched the marketing website.
Fixed path-probing agents (ReconBot, CrawlerBot) reporting fake findings on SPA-fallback sites, plus the same false-positive class in AuthzTester, HeaderPoker, and Injector.
Origin-scope enforcement on every request, TLS verification restored, strict desktop CSP, Live Attack cancel button, --max-requests cap, and a pre-publish benchmark gate.
Fixed the Dashboard/Reports risk-band mismatch and Live Attack silently doing nothing; Settings can now pick your own local Ollama model.
The desktop app now bundles the Argus CLI directly inside the installer instead of depending on a PATH-reachable install.
